engagements.title: Advancing Systems Thinking for SDG Implementation
engagements.description: In a masterclass hosted by the United Nations Sustainable Development Solutions Network (UN SDSN) Youth Nigeria as part of the SDGs Advocate Programme, I shared practical insights on how to apply systems thinking to real-world challenges, understand the interconnections between the SDGs, and design more effective, grounded solutions within local contexts.

engagements.title: Accelerating the SDGs
engagements.description: In a webinar hosted by the Society of Petroleum Engineers Lagos State University (SPE LASU) Student Chapter, I shared my insights on how can we create inclusive and equitable solutions, what does advancing sustainability mean for Africa today and how can youth-driven efforts spark meaningful change in our communities?
